description: This file contains a PHP class 'Jira' implementing a client for Jira's REST API, including methods for authentication, retrieving user info, issues, statuses, transitions, changelogs, comments, and other Jira-related operations.

classes.name: Jira
classes.description: A client class for interfacing with Jira's REST API, providing methods for user management, issue handling, status, transitions, changelogs, comments, and other Jira operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Jira client with configuration parameters, sets up the RestRequest object, and performs configuration validation.

methods.name: configCheck
methods.description: Validates that essential configuration parameters like host, username, and password are set, throws exceptions if missing.

methods.name: testLogin
methods.description: Tests the connection by attempting to retrieve the current user; returns true if successful.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user information based on the username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves user information based on email address.

methods.name: getMyself
methods.description: Fetches details of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all possible statuses from Jira.

methods.name: getTransitions
methods.description: Retrieves possible transitions for a specific issue.

methods.name: getChangelog
methods.description: Fetches changelog for a specific issue, optionally returning it as text.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments for a specific issue.

methods.name: queryIssue
methods.description: Performs a JQL search query to find issues matching certain criteria.

methods.name: createIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Jira issue with specified fields.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds an attachment file to a given issue.

methods.name: updateIssue
methods.description: Updates an existing issue with new fields.

methods.name: transitionIssue
methods.description: Transitions an issue to a new status using a transition ID.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue.

methods.name: checkUserPermissionsForProject
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific permissions for a project.

methods.name: getIssueTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available issue types.

methods.name: getPriorities
methods.description: Retrieves available priorities.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves versions for a given project.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components for a given project.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches details for a specific project.

methods.name: getCreateIssueFields
methods.description: Retrieves mapping of issue types to fields for creating issues within projects.

methods.name: getCreateIssueMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about issue creation fields and options, optionally filtered by project keys.
